description: This file declares interfaces related to warning reporting control within the WPEFramework, including warning event structures, reporting units, and control interfaces for configuring warning categories.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning events, including categorization, serialization, deserialization, and warning type identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for a warning reporting unit, responsible for reporting warning events and managing categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Controller interface for configuring warning categories: excluding, configuring, and cloning.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Exclude a specified category from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configure settings for the warning category.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a clone of the warning reporting control.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Report a warning event with a specific identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieve information about a warning category, including its default status, enablement, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Add a warning category control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Remove a warning category control from the category list.
